calculators.formula: Original weighted risk-factor index (0–100), not an event-probability model

calculators.summary_en: Calculates a standard z-score from a measurement, reference mean and SD supplied by the user. It does not reproduce WHO LMS tables.
calculators.summary_bn: User-provided measurement, reference mean ও SD থেকে standard z-score হিসাব করে। এটি WHO LMS table কপি করে না।
refs: Use official WHO growth references for clinical assessment

calculators.summary_en: Original kidney-risk factor index using eGFR, UACR, diabetes, systolic pressure and age. It is not KFRE and does not predict kidney-failure probability.
calculators.summary_bn: eGFR, UACR, diabetes, systolic pressure ও age থেকে original kidney-risk factor index। এটি KFRE নয়।
calculators.formula: Original weighted factor index (0–100), not KFRE

calculators.summary_en: Rule-based nutrition profile combining activity, sleep, fruit/vegetable intake, protein and fiber to highlight priorities. It is not a medical AI diagnosis.
calculators.summary_bn: Activity, sleep, ফল-সবজি, protein ও fiber intake মিলিয়ে priority দেখায়। এটি medical AI diagnosis নয়।

calculators.summary_en: Original food-diversity score using weekly plant variety, fermented-food frequency and fiber intake. It does not infer microbiome sequencing results.
calculators.summary_bn: Weekly plant variety, fermented food frequency ও fiber intake থেকে original diet-diversity score। এটি microbiome sequencing result অনুমান করে না।

calculators.summary_en: Nutrition-oriented muscle risk screen using age, protein intake, strength activity and recent unintentional weight loss.
calculators.summary_bn: Age, protein intake, strength activity ও recent unintentional weight loss ব্যবহার করে nutrition-oriented muscle risk screen।
calculators.formula: Original screening score (0–100), not a diagnosis

calculators.summary_en: Evaluates how evenly daily protein is distributed across three meals.
calculators.summary_bn: দৈনিক protein তিনটি meal-এর মধ্যে কতটা evenly distributed তা মূল্যায়ন করে।
calculators.formula: Balance score from breakfast, lunch and dinner protein

calculators.summary_en: Tracks the number of distinct plant foods eaten in a week.
